Thanks Evelyn / Claire. A couple of clarifying points from security: 

1) Scope: please confirm whether you want us to include: key rotation policies (KMS integration + HSM options), encryption-at-rest details (disk / object storage), and server-side vs client-side encryption patterns.
2) Audit logs: sample retention youre targeting (30/90/365 days), and whether you need immutable logs/audit trail exports for long-term retention. We can demo the log pipeline and how we redact PII before exporting if that helps.
3) SSO: brief sequence diagram for IdP-initiated vs SP-initiated flows, and the location of assertion logs.

If HealthSync can upload a short list of required artifacts to the Drive folder (or attach in reply), we'll target the walkthrough to those specifics. Preferred slot for Redwood: Wed 2026-07-21 11:00-12:15 ET (gives us time to prep both hosted/dedicated KMS examples).
